module.name: BNK Deprecated CRDs (Legacy)
module.description: Installs deprecated/legacy Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) for backward compatibility with older BNK versions. Only required for legacy deployments.

required.reason: Provides registry authentication and CRD version information

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster (used for resource identification)

required.name: crd_deprecated_version
required.description: Version of deprecated CRDs to install

required.name: far_setup_complete
required.description: Dependency flag ensuring FAR setup is complete

key_outputs.name: crds_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating deprecated CRDs are installed
